pkgmetadata.longdescription: Gentoo Settings brings the CachyOS-Settings performance and desktop tuning to Gentoo, on OpenRC or systemd, as separate tweaks that can be switched on and off: zram, swappiness, dirty bytes, I/O schedulers, transparent huge pages, watchdogs, audio power saving, gaming limits and more. Every change is shown before it is applied; privileged actions go through the gentoo-settings-helper program and its polkit policy.
